name: opentax
description: Use an OpenTax MCP server to prepare and review Japanese bookkeeping, billing, evidence, assets, and reports.

interface.longDescription: Use OpenTax tools for scoped bookkeeping, evidence, billing drafts, fixed assets, financial reports, and tax previews. OpenTax validates and records structured requests; people review pending journals in the app.
defaultPrompt: Show my OpenTax business context and recent pending journals.
Prepare journal entries from these transactions for my review.
Summarize this fiscal year's profit and loss and tax preview.
